_comment: The sensitive paths (design 6.2, 6.4), listed once. A change touching one needs local AI review runs until one is clean (peras/core/workspace/bin/review-branch.py reads this file); an area with 'codeowners' also gets a CODEOWNERS sign-off, which scripts/sensitive_paths.py generates as the last block of each repo's CODEOWNERS (last match wins, so it overrides the docs-owner lines above it, which stay by hand, design 6.5) and verify-settings.py checks. 'paths' maps a repo ('*': every managed repo) to its patterns, in CODEOWNERS syntax limited to: '*' (the whole repo), '/dir/' (a folder and everything in it) or '/path/file' (one file), all from the repo's root. Every repo's CODEOWNERS is listed wherever GitHub would read it, so the sign-off covers itself; so are the root files that configure a check or a bot (Renovate, Gitleaks and its ignore list, Semgrep and a repo's own rules, the root package scripts and workspace that decide what the checks run, and the git hooks), since editing one can switch it off. '*' entries aren't checked for existence. 'planned' lists folders 4.2 plans but that don't exist yet (the API's payment and account modules, the review worker), covered from the day they land; verify-settings.py checks every other path exists, that a planned path's parent folder does, and reports a planned path that now exists so it moves to 'paths'. 'team' owns the sign-off (rulesets/teams.json).
